tasks.title: groupBy in src/leaf-6.js
tasks.description: Group a list by one field.

context.reason: the test that decides whether this task worked

edits.change: Write a module whose only export is groupBy(items, key): an object whose keys are the values found at key in each item, each holding the items that share it in the order they came, with the keys themselves in the order they were first seen. So groupBy([{ k: 'a' }, { k: 'b' }, { k: 'a' }], 'k') is { a: [{ k: 'a' }, { k: 'a' }], b: [{ k: 'b' }] } and groupBy([], 'k') is {}.

edits.change: Make this the entry point of the toolkit: import taxRate from './schema.js', net from './leaf-1.js', lineTotal from './leaf-2.js', discount from './leaf-3.js', taxOn from './leaf-4.js', toCents from './leaf-5.js' and groupBy from './leaf-6.js', and re-exporting all seven by name. Then add invoiceTotal(lines): start a total at 0 and for each line, which is an object with unit, qty, an optional discountPct and a kind, set sub to lineTotal(line.unit, line.qty), then when line.discountPct is set set sub to discount(sub, line.discountPct), then set the total to net(total + sub + taxOn(sub, taxRate(line.kind))). Return the total, so invoiceTotal([]) is 0. Add reportCents(lines), which is toCents of that total, and groupLines(lines), which is groupBy of the lines on their kind. Leave every function in the leaf modules and the tax table exactly as they are.
